explanation: The closing claim that this set is what forgetting a policy removes is not exact. For a list element, listing adds the list key as an entry with no value name (line 255-256 else branch), but forgetting does not add that entry: it clears every value under the key and forgets the key clearance (253-254), then forgets each collected entry. Say the key entry appears only in the listed set, and that forgetting treats a list key by clearing all its values. Also, equality of entries is case-insensitive on key and value (RegistryKeyValuePair, 432-446), so a value named twice in different letter case counts once. The findings file also holds two lines under this id; leave one.
